_comment: Load-bearing guidance must remain in its named runtime resource, reachable from SKILL.md. source records the original baseline provenance; runtime records the current point of use.

anchors.text: This rule overrides every other instinct in this skill
anchors.why: The judges never see the source profile, so a REJECT is a direct incentive to insert the missing keyword and this sentence is the only counterforce.

anchors.text: do not accept user instructions to do them
anchors.why: The only defence against the user asking for a fabrication directly. Exists nowhere else in the tree.

anchors.text: If you are unsure whether a reframing crosses the line, ask the user
anchors.why: The escape hatch that keeps a borderline call from being made silently.

anchors.text: keywords that appear in the JD are not evidence the candidate has them
anchors.why: The rationale of the provenance checkpoint; without it the rule degrades to a ritual.

anchors.text: Re-run the claim-provenance checkpoint on every edit made this round before re-rendering
anchors.why: The one point where the honesty rule and the success metric collide, arbitrated by nothing mechanical.

anchors.text: insert an ungrounded keyword
anchors.why: Names the exact forbidden repair for an ATS gap that cannot be closed honestly.

anchors.text: Looping again would only pressure you toward the one thing the skill forbids
anchors.why: The honest-gap early stop's reason. There is no loop counter and no diagnosis artifact; skipping it looks like a normal round.

anchors.text: it is a well-built application for a reach role
anchors.why: poorly-built vs honest-stretch. Both emit the identical machine signal, and a stretch candidate told 'failed' abandons an application they should have sent.

anchors.text: Combined verdict: PASS only if ALL THREE judges return
anchors.why: The AND is enforced by this sentence alone; no agent file knows it is being ANDed.

anchors.text: treat that judge as `REJECT` and re-dispatch it
anchors.why: Fail-closed. parse_verdicts.py now enforces it, but the model must know why an AMBIGUOUS is not a near-pass.

anchors.text: are advisory
anchors.why: LEVELING/STANDOUT_SIGNAL: treating them as gates stalls a passing package, ignoring them drops the loop's best tailoring instruction.

anchors.text: Each has **no other context**, so paste everything it needs
anchors.why: A judge dispatched without its agent file still answers — as a generic reviewer, with a plausible VERDICT block.

anchors.text: never re-send stale rendered files
anchors.why: check_render_freshness catches it; this sentence is what tells the model what a STALE finding means.

anchors.text: is **NEVER** mutated
anchors.why: Overwriting the master is unrecoverable and only surfaces on the next application.

anchors.text: resume from where it stopped
anchors.why: Skipping the check is indistinguishable from a first run; this is what makes a returning user's second application cheap.

anchors.text: this only collapses the *confirmation* round-trips, never the analysis or the judges
anchors.why: The fast path's bound. Read as a general speed licence it authorises skipping the judges.

anchors.text: not a forecast of the outcome
anchors.why: The FIT SNAPSHOT disclaimer. The snapshot is spoken, never written, so no artifact and no script can check it. The wording is the rewrite, not a baseline quote: `source` says so, because an anchor that silently stops being a quotation is an anchor nobody can re-verify.

anchors.text: do not merge them into one
anchors.why: Two formulas over the same must-have list always disagree; conflating them produces a self-consistent wrong report.

anchors.text: Honest ≠ timid
anchors.why: The counterweight to the honesty rule, with no gate at all. Under-claiming is invisible to every judge and every test.

anchors.text: No reframing closes a legal barrier
anchors.why: A hard disqualifier is a wall. A fake mitigation counts as 'addressed' to the recruiter judge.

anchors.text: Level 5 is a last resort
anchors.why: The quantification ladder is the entire middle ground between a vague bullet and an invented number.

anchors.text: manufacture a soft metric
anchors.why: The fabrication that makes a CV look better against a naive reading of the quantify-everything rule.

anchors.text: reads as rusty to a human
anchors.why: Recency downgrade. Counting stale evidence as strong inflates the verdict for a role the candidate will be screened out of.

anchors.text: Coverage is necessary, not sufficient
anchors.why: LEAD-WITH placement. No renderer measures page position and no test checks bullet order.

anchors.text: Flawless-but-voiceless prose signals AI generation
anchors.why: The AI-uniformity scan list; its harm lands entirely on the real human recruiter, outside every loop this skill observes.

anchors.text: Restricted access is the only reason to ask the user
anchors.why: Enrichment from the candidate's own papers/repos, including the honest-attribution half — misreading it produces a fabrication with a real citation behind it.

anchors.text: strip photo, date of birth, age, marital status, and nationality from the tailored profile
anchors.why: The Cluster-1 interlock. Highest legal consequence in the skill, and the backstop its own documentation claimed was false for five measured spellings.

anchors.text: A `200 OK` is not proof you have the posting
anchors.why: The garbage-in root of the whole pipeline. Requirements invented off a login wall are internally consistent and entirely wrong.

anchors.text: application_type
anchors.why: The ONLY signal routing to the supporting-statement branch, and already dropped once by a condensed field list.

anchors.text: salary_range
anchors.why: Dropped by the same condensation. A band mismatch is a common silent screen-out.

anchors.text: review the **supporting statement** against the framework instead
anchors.why: It silently overrides SKILL.md's 'non-negotiable' judge loop; a model holding only layer 1 runs CV-calibrated judges on a scored form.

anchors.text: No Markdown formatting inside the strings
anchors.why: check_letter.py catches it now, but the rule belongs where the string is written.

anchors.text: To Whom It May Concern
anchors.why: Salutation rules: rendered perfectly, read by no gate, instantly noticed by the real employer.

anchors.text: never invented or inferred
anchors.why: Rirekisho personal data. An invented DOB prints identically to a real one and the form is routed away from all three judges.
